plan.title: Local Context Supply Chain — front-loaded retrieval-gated context
plan.goal: Assemble a local task's context ONCE at dispatch (embed-directed: code span + prior fixes + skill + best-practice + docs + memory, token-budgeted) so Qwen reasons over a small complete prompt. In-loop retrieval = bounded fallback. Optimizes for fewest prefills/steps on the re-prefill-every-call APU.
plan.tier_model: DEFINED=spec exists; INTEGRATED=assembler wired on live dispatch behind default-on flag; VALIDATED=real slice runs with front-loaded context, prefill/steps measured vs dogfood-01 baseline; ACCEPTED=owner sign-off.

items.name: context_assembler.py + dispatch wiring + test
items.validation_goal: code task pulls >=2 collections; respects token_budget; fail-open; fires on live dispatch
